summary.registryStatus: All seven non-Castle secondary pickups are registered as pickupSecondary in src/assets/runtimeUniverseAssets.ts.
summary.preloadStatus: RuntimeAssetResolver preloads pickupSecondary for normal and boss levels.
summary.renderRule: PickupRenderer uses the secondary texture only for active pickup indexes where i % 2 === 1.
summary.overallDecision: Do not delete in PATCH 1093. Paperboy can actively display a secondary pickup; the other universes are wired but appear legacy-suspect because current mechanics usually expose only one active pickup.

codeEvidence.evidence: pickupSecondary is declared for sonic, streets, fighter, outrun, shinobi, kombat, and paperboy.
ROLES_NORMAL and ROLES_BOSS both include pickupSecondary.
Secondary texture is selected only when the active pickup index is odd.
getActivePickups returns one active pickup for Sonic, Shinobi, OutRun, and generic normal flows; Paperboy can combine the carried-paper pickup with delivery targets.
